omissions.title: Action Hero caches an effective critical chance and writes it as a raw item value, conflicting with weapon-trait writers
omissions.reproduction_evidence: For a sharp weapon, getCriticalChance returns raw critical chance multiplied by sharpness, but setCriticalChance writes raw. Action Hero then competes with Axes/Cleaver absolute writers; last writer wins and transitions can strand a bonus.
omissions.missing_proof: Save/load persistence of the raw Java field was not observed in game; same-world item handoff and non-composition are statically proven.
omissions.recommended_correction: Replace independent absolute setters with one per-source aggregate or calculate bonuses at hit time; restore on swap, drop, transfer, and trait loss.
omissions.smallest_regression_test: Use a sharp weapon with Action Hero plus Axes/Cleaver, toggle each effect, swap and transfer the item, and assert additive composition and exact base restoration.

omissions.recommended_correction: Install each wrapper once, preserve the true original once, and make repeated installation a no-op.
omissions.smallest_regression_test: Fire OnGameStart twice, perform one matching consumption action, and assert one original call and one trait effect.

cross_trait_findings.title: Independent critical-chance writers are non-composable and use mismatched effective/raw domains
cross_trait_findings.reproduction_evidence: Each trait caches and writes an absolute critical chance on the same weapon. HandWeapon.getCriticalChance returns raw multiplied by sharpness while setCriticalChance writes raw; combined traits overwrite rather than compose and item transitions can strand a bonus.
cross_trait_findings.missing_proof: The raw Java field's independent save/load persistence was not observed; same-world composition and handoff defects are statically proven.
cross_trait_findings.recommended_correction: Use one raw-domain-safe per-source aggregate or calculate bonuses at hit time, with complete swap/drop/transfer/trait-loss restoration.
cross_trait_findings.smallest_regression_test: Use a non-unit-sharpness weapon with Action Hero plus Axes or Cleaver, toggle both effects, transfer the item, and assert additive composition and exact base restoration.

cross_trait_findings.title: Shared food-timer polling does not represent ordinary meals and is inconsistently throttled
cross_trait_findings.reproduction_evidence: Anorexy, Competitive Eater, and Bad Teeth are resolved through exact post-consumption hooks. Ascetic retains a food-timer polling path pending the explicit stress-unit decision.
cross_trait_findings.missing_proof: No current-game meal trace establishes that every intended meal reaches hunger zero and raises the timer by more than 50.
cross_trait_findings.recommended_correction: Use an idempotent exact consumption edge or narrow the descriptions; apply a documented bounded cadence wherever polling remains.
cross_trait_findings.smallest_regression_test: Exercise partial, fully satiating, exactly-50, and dangerous-uncooked meals while counting handler calls over a fixed update window.
